entries.title: Exodus 35:1
segments: ¶Then Moses gathered all the congregation of the children of Israel together, and said to them, "These [are] the words which the LORD has commanded [you] to do:

entries.title: Exodus 35:2
segments: "Work shall be done for six days, but the seventh day shall be a holy day for you, a Sabbath of rest to the LORD. Whoever does any work on it shall be put to death.

entries.title: Exodus 35:3
segments: "You shall kindle no fire throughout your dwellings on the Sabbath day."

entries.title: Exodus 35:4
segments: And Moses spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, "This [is] the thing which the LORD commanded, saying:

entries.title: Exodus 35:5
segments: 'Take from among you an offering to the LORD. Whoever [is] of a willing heart, let him bring it as an offering to the LORD: gold, silver, and bronze;

entries.title: Exodus 35:6
segments: 'blue, purple, and scarlet [thread], fine linen, and goats' [hair];

entries.title: Exodus 35:7
segments: 'ram skins dyed red, badger skins, and acacia wood;

entries.title: Exodus 35:8
segments: 'oil for the light, and spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense;

entries.title: Exodus 35:9
segments: 'onyx stones, and stones to be set in the ephod and in the breastplate.

entries.title: Exodus 35:10
segments: 'All [who are] gifted artisans among you shall come and make all that the LORD has commanded:

entries.title: Exodus 35:11
segments: 'the tabernacle, its tent, its covering, its clasps, its boards, its bars, its pillars, and its sockets;

entries.title: Exodus 35:12
segments: 'the ark and its poles, [with] the mercy seat, and the veil of the covering;

entries.title: Exodus 35:13
segments: 'the table and its poles, all its utensils, and the showbread;

entries.title: Exodus 35:14
segments: 'also the lampstand for the light, its utensils, its lamps, and the oil for the light;

entries.title: Exodus 35:15
segments: 'the incense altar, its poles, the anointing oil, the sweet incense, and the screen for the door at the entrance of the tabernacle;

entries.title: Exodus 35:16
segments: 'the altar of burnt offering with its bronze grating, its poles, all its utensils, [and] the laver and its base;

entries.title: Exodus 35:17
segments: 'the hangings of the court, its pillars, their sockets, and the screen for the gate of the court;

entries.title: Exodus 35:18
segments: 'the pegs of the tabernacle, the pegs of the court, and their cords;

entries.title: Exodus 35:19
segments: 'the garments of ministry, for ministering in the holy [place] -the holy garments for Aaron the priest and the garments of his sons, to minister as priests.'"

entries.title: Exodus 35:20
segments: ¶And all the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.

entries.title: Exodus 35:21
segments: Then everyone came whose heart was stirred, and everyone whose spirit was willing, [and] they brought the LORD'S offering for the work of the tabernacle of meeting, for all its service, and for the holy garments.

entries.title: Exodus 35:22
segments: They came, both men and women, as many as had a willing heart, [and] brought earrings and nose rings, rings and necklaces, all jewelry of gold, that is, every man who [made] an offering of gold to the LORD.

entries.title: Exodus 35:23
segments: And every man, with whom was found blue, purple, and scarlet [thread], fine linen, and goats' [hair], red skins of rams, and badger skins, brought [them].

entries.title: Exodus 35:24
segments: Everyone who offered an offering of silver or bronze brought the LORD'S offering. And everyone with whom was found acacia wood for any work of the service, brought [it].

entries.title: Exodus 35:25
segments: All the women [who were] gifted artisans spun yarn with their hands, and brought what they had spun, of blue, purple, [and] scarlet, and fine linen.

entries.title: Exodus 35:26
segments: And all the women whose heart stirred with wisdom spun yarn of goats' [hair].

entries.title: Exodus 35:27
segments: The rulers brought onyx stones, and the stones to be set in the ephod and in the breastplate,

entries.title: Exodus 35:28
segments: and spices and oil for the light, for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense.

entries.title: Exodus 35:29
segments: The children of Israel brought a freewill offering to the LORD, all the men and women whose hearts were willing to bring [material] for all kinds of work which the LORD, by the hand of Moses, had commanded to be done.

entries.title: Exodus 35:30
segments: ¶And Moses said to the children of Israel, "See, the LORD has called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah;

entries.title: Exodus 35:31
segments: "and He has filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom and understanding, in knowledge and all manner of workmanship,

entries.title: Exodus 35:32
segments: "to design artistic works, to work in gold and silver and bronze,

entries.title: Exodus 35:33
segments: "in cutting jewels for setting, in carving wood, and to work in all manner of artistic workmanship.

entries.title: Exodus 35:34
segments: "And He has put in his heart the ability to teach, [in] him and Aholiab the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.

entries.title: Exodus 35:35
segments: "He has filled them with skill to do all manner of work of the engraver and the designer and the tapestry maker, in blue, purple, and scarlet [thread], and fine linen, and of the weaver-those who do every work and those who design artistic works.
